description: We’re Axiom, five Computer Engineering students from Birzeit University: Leen, Shahd, Twaba, Duha, and Nidal. Our skills span AI, software, embedded systems, and cybersecurity. We're developing a wearable bracelet and sleeve that monitor astronauts’ health and provide early warnings during long missions. We're looking for teammates skilled in biomedical sciences, ML, UI/UX, electronics, or storytelling to help us build an innovative, working prototype!
